name: Get Program Member Fields
summary: Lists all fields on the program member object (standard + custom) with their API names and data types. Paged, 300 per page.
whenToUse: When you need the exact field API names to use in Sync Program Member Data rows or Get Program Members filters.

query.name: batchSize
query.label: Batch size (max per page)
query.hint: Optional. Max 300. Smaller pages are easier to read.

query.name: nextPageToken
query.label: Next page token
query.hint: Optional. Copy nextPageToken from the previous response to continue.

response.description: Field metadata: name, displayName, dataType, isCustom, and more.
